method: Fresh screenshots exported from current native XCTest bundles on isolated iPhone and Apple TV simulators, using the real backend and an isolated public-art/synthetic-media fixture. Screenshots were encoded as JPEG at quality 90; TV output was scaled from 3840×2160 to 1920×1080. No compositing or interface reconstruction.

fixture_data.media: Tiny synthetic local clips, an illustrative Blender Open Movies demo series, generated music, and disposable accounts.
fixture_data.metadata: Movie titles/years and artwork match Spring (2019), Cosmos Laundromat (2015), and Sintel (2010). Demo watch progress and film-rating values are synthetic; they are not editorial claims about the films.
fixture_data.artwork: Approved Blender Studio / Blender Foundation posters and backdrops from docs/assets/blender-sources.json, Creative Commons Attribution.
fixture_data.privacy: No household server, private media, real credentials, or private hostnames.
fixture_data.appearance: Dark member preference; iPhone simulator dark appearance.
fixture_data.capture_harness: Temporary copy of apple/scripts/proof_server.py with public artwork/title mappings and title-logo-only verification removed. Canonical app source was unchanged.
fixture_data.native_qualification: Capture evidence only. Does not certify all native workflows or physical-device codec/output support.
